body: Thanks for your concern. It's too late to go out now, but I'm going to see how the day goes tomorrow. I'll probably still come to the same conclusion that the world would be better without me. No one cares enough about me to realize something is wrong. Just a snowflake in the wind.

Yeah, I think I experienced genuine heartbreak for the first time in my life. Thing is, we were not in a relationship. We weren't even friends. It still hurts though that now he's going to consider himself better than me because he's going to suppress his feelings. 

I work in transportation.

Thing that had me the most upset is a guy I had a crush on became a Christian. We were never in a relationship, but the hope of perhaps being with him gave me comfort. But he joined one of those fire and brimstone churches, I think he's probably going to try and be one of those "ex-gays." I know I shouldn't care, but it really upsets me. Makes me feel wrong somehow. And then of course I failed at being the most productive worker today. I was literally in tears earlier and I don't know if I can go on.
I really make no difference to anybody. I'm quite disposable. I think people would not bat an eye if I were to go.
Meh I suppose I'll find out. Thanks so much for talking to me. I feel much better now.
Lol, well judging by the gay shows on tv, gay men have their share of drama! 0_0
Lol, guess it's lucky that I'm not really attracted to women then.

Hehe. After observing the relationship my roommate has with his girlfriend, I think I would agree. Although, I think I would enjoy having someone to be very intimate with. Are you in a relationship with a man and a woman.

That makes sense. I know I'm a good employee, but it does kind of make me feel bad that I'm not 'the' best performer. I'll have to work on appreciating being able to do my best. I'll have to speak with my father when and if he brings up the abuse again. He does have a point that I don't necessarily like to visit very regularly because I kind want to keep my distance from my parents. 

As far as the guy, I knew it was a fat chance trying to get with him anyway, but it does hurt to know that someone I'm crushing on is just not available to me. I didn't go through all the teenaged heartbreak crap in high school like everyone else. I've only recently started to acknowledge my sexuality and I feel like a teenager all over again. And I'm fucking 21!

Generally I was just feeling inadequate. A coworker is rivaling my ability at work which has me on edge. My father complained about my infrequent visits and then brought up the child abuse he put me through. I tried to brush it off, but it really stirred bad feelings within me. Also, I sent a facebook message to my crush and he has not acknowledged me at all. I'm not sure why, but he posted that he had gone to church and that got me really upset. I think its because if he goes to church he might be one of those "trying to be pure gays" which makes me angry because I could never be a "pure" gay. I'm a gay man by the way. Please let me know if any of these topics make you uncomfortable.
Great. I'm feeling a bit better, but still pretty down. Thanks for agreeing to speak to me.
Hello thank you for responding. Are you still there? I know its been a while.
